title: 第19章 黑松林路见不平拔刀相助第20章 我就没打算走
slug: 亿倍返还双手插兜没有对手
lines: 听到求救声，苏长歌眼眸一凝。
他虽不是圣母。
但正魔不两立，惩恶扬善的事做一次也未尝不可！
心中也骤然升起一股豪爽的感觉：路见不平一声吼，该出手时就出手！
他驾驭长剑，朝着黑松林飞去。
此时，黑松林深处。
日光被遮掩，四周黑暗昏沉，一股魔气笼罩，仿佛乌云压顶，让人心悸！
一名三十多岁的美妇倒在地上，嘴角溢出几丝鲜血。
她颇有姿色，身穿紫色旗袍，凹凸有致的身材，若隐若现。
只是这旗袍，现在却被撕去了一大块。
“叫吧，你就算叫上了天，也不会有人救你的！
今天，我要定你了！”
一名身披黑甲，头戴黑白两色鬼脸面具的青年狞笑着，向她寸寸逼近。
他身上的威压太浑厚了，魔威肆虐，每走一步，都像是黑暗在驱逐光明，黑暗中传出鬼怪撕心裂肺的尖叫，让人脊背发凉。
此人，半步法相境！
身上仅是威压溢出，就如一尊山岳凌空压下，碾压的美妇脸色苍白，目露绝望。
她抓住最后一丝救命稻草，希望能唤醒青年最后一丝良知，道：“小兄弟，你看样子应该二十出头，我比你大了十多岁，而且我有家室，你……”
说到家室，美妇顿了一下，眸中流露出痛惜。
在她身旁不远的空地上，停着一辆马车。
马车早已破碎，被从中间劈为两半，一名三十多岁的中年倒在半截马车里。
他被拦腰斩断，鲜血横流。
“比我大？”
佩戴鬼脸面具的青年狞笑一声，道：“小爷我就好这口！”
他眼中流露邪光，在美妇身上仔细扫过，不放过一寸一缕，口中发出赞叹：“好啊！
好啊！”
说话之际，他一步步的逼近美妇，眼中邪光越发炽热！
美妇彻底绝望了。
家门不幸，她今日和夫君一起出行，不料来到这这黑松林之时，碰到魔道，夫君被杀，钱财被抢，她也即将惨遭玷污……
这黑松林，叫天天不应，叫地地不灵。
可以想象，等待她的，将是一场暴行。
突然，虚空划过一道闪电，伴随着正义的光芒，有雄厚的威压浮现，卷起千层风浪，似排山倒海，风卷残云！
“什么人！”
content_en:
Hearing the cry for help, Su Changge's eyes narrowed.
Although he is not the Holy Mother.
But there is no coexistence between good and evil, so it’s not a bad thing to do once to punish evil and promote good!
A bold feeling suddenly arose in my heart: when I saw injustice on the road, I roared, and when it was time to take action, I took action!
"Phew!"
He harnessed the long sword and flew towards the black pine forest.
At this time, deep in the black pine forest.
The sunlight was blocked, the surroundings were dark and gloomy, and a demonic aura shrouded it, as if dark clouds were pressing over it, making people feel heart palpitating!
A beautiful woman in her thirties fell to the ground, with a few traces of blood spilling from the corner of her mouth.
She is quite pretty, wearing a purple cheongsam, and her curvy figure is vaguely visible.
But now a large piece of this cheongsam has been torn off.
"Scream, even if you scream to the sky, no one will save you!
Today, I’m going to book you! "
A young man wearing black armor and a black and white ghost face mask grinned ferociously, approaching her inch by inch.
The coercion on him was too strong, and the demonic power was raging. Every step he took was like darkness expelling light. The heart-rending screams of ghosts could be heard in the darkness, sending chills down one's spine.
This person is half a step into the realm of appearance!
The pressure just overflowed from her body, just like a mountain pressing down from the sky. The beautiful woman who was crushed was pale and her eyes were desperate.
She grabbed the last straw, hoping to awaken the last trace of conscience in the young man, and said: "Little brother, you look like you are in your early twenties. I am more than ten years older than you, and I have a family. You..."
Speaking of family, the beautiful woman paused for a moment, with regret in her eyes.
There was a carriage parked in the open space not far from her.
The carriage was already broken, split in half from the middle, and a middle-aged man in his thirties fell inside half of the carriage.
He was cut off at the waist and blood flowed freely.
"Bigger than me?"
The young man wearing the grimace mask gave a ferocious smile and said, "This is what I like, young master!"
There was an evil light in his eyes, and he scanned the beautiful woman's body carefully, not missing an inch, and exclaimed in praise: "Okay!
OK! "
As he spoke, he approached the beautiful woman step by step, and the evil light in his eyes became more and more fiery!
The beautiful woman was completely desperate.
The family is unlucky. She was traveling with her husband today. Unexpectedly, when she came to this black pine forest, she encountered a demon. Her husband was killed and her money was robbed. She was about to be defiled...
In this black pine forest, the sky is not responding and the earth is not working.
It is conceivable that what awaits her will be an atrocity.
"Boom!"
Suddenly, a flash of lightning flashed through the void, and along with the light of justice, a strong coercion emerged, rolling up thousands of wind and waves, like overwhelming mountains and seas, and the wind and the remaining clouds!
"Who!"
title_en: Chapter 19: Drawing a sword to help when there is injustice on the black pine forest road Chapter 20: I have no intention of leaving
